answer: The lantern index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1453 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the harbor. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the voyage queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The fee repeats 30 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
